title: Keeping Threatened Toads Safe During Breeding Season
summary: Why did the Yosemite toad cross the road? To find a mate and help continue its species — all while avoiding traffic, something Southern California Edison is helping make sure ...
body_text: Why did the Yosemite toad cross the road? To find a mate and help continue its species — all while avoiding traffic, something Southern California Edison is helping make sure of. “These toads are really tiny. Sometimes the young ones look like pebbles,” said Stephanie Fincher, an SCE senior advisor in Hydro Licensing and Water Management. “Unfortunately, that’s why a lot of them are at risk of getting struck by vehicles.” Protecting Yosemite toads is one way SCE helps support healthy Sierra Nevada ecosystems when working in the area to produce clean energy through the Big Creek Hydroelectric Project. The federally threatened amphibians — found only in California — are vulnerable to traffic when they emerge from hibernation each spring and make their way to high-elevation wetlands like Kaiser Meadow , one of the species’ most important breeding grounds in the Sierra Nevada. After laying eggs, the toads disperse back into the surrounding forest. The round trip often requires crossing Kaiser Pass Road. “Kaiser Pass Road is an important connection through the Sierra backcountry,” said Fincher. “We use it to access the structures and equipment that make up SCE’s Big Creek Hydroelectric Project , and the public uses the road seasonally to reach campgrounds, hiking trails and reservoirs.” SCE teams in the Sierra move extra carefully during the toads’ breeding season and dispersal period. Annual training teaches them how to identify Yosemite toads and what to do if they encounter one on a roadway. While many of these practices are required as part of environmental commitments associated with SCE’s hydropower operations, the crews embrace them as an opportunity to help protect a species that calls the Sierra home. “After years of training, our crews get excited when they see Yosemite toads. They want to protect them,” said Fincher. “A lot of us live here on this mountain, in this forest. It's our backyard and we care about it.” Found only in California, Yosemite toads return to high-elevation meadows each year to breed and help sustain future generations. PHOTO CREDIT: U.S. Forest Service During certain projects, trained wildlife monitors accompany SCE crews traveling through the “toad zone” near Kaiser Meadow. Before vehicles enter the area, a monitor walks ahead, scanning the roadway for toads and safely moving any out of harm’s way. “It’s definitely a unique, meticulous practice,” said Caroline Hamilton, a biologist from SCE’s contracted monitoring service provider. “We're doing our best to keep the population stable by mitigating one of the factors that we can actually have some control of.” If a toad does find itself on the pavement, it can also use one of the specially made “toad escape ramps” that crews carve out of the roadside snow embankments. SCE coordinates the work with the U.S. Forest Service, which oversees the habitat and helps guide conservation strategies. Each year, SCE crews create toad escape ramps as part of ongoing efforts to support Yosemite toads moving through the Sierra backcountry. PHOTO CREDIT: Lisa Aubry “When we spot Yosemite toads, we document and share our observations with the Forest Service, so biologists can better understand where crossings happen and make any needed adjustments to safeguard the toads,” said Fincher. Coordinated efforts to protect the Yosemite toad go beyond preserving a single species — the toads’ presence is a sign of healthy mountain meadows and wetlands that support a wide variety of plants and wildlife. “We want to make sure we produce clean energy from our hydroelectric systems while honoring our responsibility to act as stewards of the environment,” said Fincher. For more information, visit sce.com/environment . Communications for this program are funded by ratepayers.

title: SurgePays' Derron Winfrey to Speak at All Wireless & Prepaid Expo 2026
summary: LinkUp Mobile to debut a disruptive new dealer and Master Distributor compensation model at the prepaid wireless industry’s premier annual event...
body_text: BARTLETT, Tenn., July 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SurgePays, Inc. (NASDAQ: SURG) (“SurgePays” or the “Company”), a wireless and fintech technology company connecting subprime and underserved consumers to essential mobile and financial services, today announced that Derron Winfrey, President of Sales and Operations at SurgePays, will speak on the featured C-Suite panel, “A Conversation with the C-Suite: The Next Era of Prepaid,” at All Wireless & Prepaid Expo 2026, the prepaid wireless industry’s premier annual event, taking place August 18-19 at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas. Winfrey will join David Kim, Chief Revenue Officer of Verizon Value , and Daniel Barsoum, Chief Executive Officer of Qué Tal Móvil , for a discussion on the next era of prepaid wireless, including distribution, branding, digital strategy, dealer partnerships, and retail profitability. The panel will be moderated by Jeff Moore, Principal of Wave 7 Research . At the event, LinkUp Mobile will debut a new dealer and Master Distributor compensation model designed to accelerate distribution growth and drive subscriber acquisition. The launch builds on SurgePays’ recently announced amendment to its wholesale carrier agreement, which is expected to lower subscriber acquisition and recurring service costs, supporting expanded operating margins as LinkUp Mobile scales. “All Wireless & Prepaid Expo is the biggest event of the year for the prepaid wireless industry, and great timing for LinkUp Mobile. Our amended wholesale carrier agreement unlocked expanded margins we intend to leverage, and the new compensation model we are debuting in Las Vegas is built to incentivize Master Distributors to significantly grow the dealer network while at the same time incentivizing dealers to push more customers to LinkUp as recurring subscribers. We have waited until our favorite show to launch our comp plan that has been years in the making and designed to be unmatched in the prepaid wireless industry,” said Derron Winfrey, President of Sales and Operations at SurgePays. SurgePays is a Silver Sponsor of All Wireless & Prepaid Expo 2026 and will exhibit at Booth #717 throughout the two-day event. Prospective Master Distributors, retail partners, and industry contacts can schedule a meeting with the SurgePays team by contacting ir@surgepays.com . About SurgePays, Inc. SurgePays, Inc. (NASDAQ: SURG) is a wireless and fintech technology company focused on expanding access to essential mobile and financial services for subprime and underserved consumers. The Company operates a nationwide ecosystem that includes its own wireless brands, LinkUp Mobile and Torch Wireless, and a proprietary point-of-sale platform deployed in thousands of retail locations, enabling wireless activations, top-ups, financial transactions, and other digital services used daily by prepaid and subprime customers. Visit www.SurgePays.com for more information. title: 2027 BMW M2 Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: In addition to a vibrant new paint color, the 2027 BMW M2 now offers all-wheel drive. Rear-wheel drive and a manual gearbox are still on the menu.
body_text: BMW’s M-badged vehicles are some of the most powerful and exciting machines in the world, and for fans of small coupes with big power, the BMW M2 may be the most intriguing of them all. Like the original muscle cars in the 1960s and 1970s, the M2 combines a big engine with a lightweight chassis, two doors, and impressive acceleration. But unlike those lumbering old brutes, the 2027 M2 is also built to go fast in more than just a straight line. 2027 BMW M2 Pricing, Specs, and Release Date What’s New for the 2027 BMW M2 Design Powertrain Interior Technology Safety Pricing and Release Date Further Research What’s New for the 2027 BMW M2 BMW has blessed the M2 lineup with its advanced xDrive all-wheel-drive (AWD) system for the first time in 2027. Like other M-badged performance cars with xDrive, the M2’s AWD system is tuned to prioritize rear-wheel-drive (RWD) dynamics under normal circumstances. When it detects too much rear-wheel slip, xDrive instantly sends power to the front wheels to maximize traction. The 2027 BMW M2 xDrive is available solely with an eight-speed automatic transmission and, while xDrive is big news for 2027, BMW still offers versions of the M2 with a six-speed manual transmission and RWD. Another addition for the 2027 model year is BMW’s Borusan Turkish Blue paint. Design The BMW M2’s exterior styling is nothing if not aggressive. It doesn’t have a huge grille like some other BMW models, but its nostrils are squared-off and filled with interesting design details. Three more massive air intakes make up the rest of the front fascia. The M2’s boxy profile, bolstered fenders, ducktail rear spoiler, and quartet of exhaust outlets complete the pugnacious look. Powertrain A twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-six that produces 473 horsepower and 443 pound-feet of torque comes standard in the 2027 BMW M2. Last year, a limited-edition M2 CS was offered with 523 hp and 479 lb-ft of torque. At the time of writing, BMW has not confirmed that the CS will be on the options list for 2027, but that doesn’t mean it won’t be in time. The manufacturer says the M2 with xDrive is 0.3 seconds quicker to 60 than the RWD version, doing the run in a scant 3.6 seconds. The 2027 M2’s top speed of 155 mph can be increased to 177 mph by opting for the M Driver’s Package. Settings accessible through the M Setup menu allow the driver to tailor the car’s AWD system to their preferences, or even unlock a RWD mode with traction control turned off. BMW has not yet released the 2027 M2’s estimated fuel economy figures, but last year, the RWD M2 was rated at 16 mpg in the city, 23 mpg on the highway, and 19 mpg combined regardless of transmission. M2 models equipped with xDrive may have lower mpg numbers because AWD adds weight. Interior BMW equips the 2027 M2 with smart interior finishes, including standard leather upholstery in black with blue contrast stitching, black with red highlights, or black with BMW’s multi-hued M color highlights. BMW offers two aluminum trim options along with an optional carbon fiber package. An Alcantara-covered steering wheel is optional, and optional M Carbon seats increase bolstering and have integral head restraints. There is a pair of rear seats, but they're quite small. Technology A 14.9-inch touchscreen display running the latest BMW Operating System 8.5 with an M Interface comes standard. The BMW Intelligent Personal Assistant understands numerous voice commands for those who prefer talking to their car rather than using the touchscreen. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are also standard. Directly in front of the driver sits a 12.3-inch display serving as a digital gauge cluster. Search for BMW M2 See all 2026 BMW M2 $70,071 6,803 miles Includes dealer fees Good Deal Kansas City, KS 2026 BMW M2 $114,586 890 miles Includes dealer fees Fair Deal Marietta, GA 2026 BMW M2 $73,787 165 miles Includes dealer fees Good Deal Mt Pleasant, SC 2026 BMW M2 $74,741 708 miles Includes dealer fees Fair Deal St Petersburg, FL 2026 BMW M2 $71,942 3,690 miles Includes dealer fees Good Deal Nashua, NH 2026 BMW M2 $69,288 2,347 miles Includes dealer fees Great Deal Pembroke Pines, FL Safety BMW equips the 2027 M2 with its Driving Assistant suite, which includes active blind-spot monitors, lane-keep assist, forward-collision warning, and a rear cross-traffic alert. Additionally, BMW’s Distance Control (adaptive cruise control) and Steering Assistant (lane-keep assist) use radar sensors and cameras for semi-autonomous capabilities. Neither the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) nor the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) had tested the BMW M2 at the time of writing. Pricing and Release Date BMW says the 2027 M2 will be on sale in the late summer of 2026. At the time of writing, only the M2 xDrive had official pricing, and it would cost $74,950 including destination. Expect 2027 M2 models with RWD to cost less. In 2026, BMW offered the M2 with several desirable options, including an enhanced Lighting Package, a head-up display, an M Carbon Roof, the M Driver’s Package that raised the top speed and included a one-day driving class, and M Carbon Bucket Seats. A full Carbon Package included unique wheels, carbon-fiber interior trim, the Carbon Bucket Seats, M Carbon Roof, and M Driver’s Package. It’s likely a similar complement of options will be offered for the 2027 model year. title: SafetyKit | The UK Online Safety Act: What Platforms Need to Know About Content Moderation Compliance
summary: The UK Online Safety Act requires platforms to detect illegal content, protect children, and verify ages. Learn OSA requirements and how to achieve compliance.
body_text: The UK Online Safety Act requires platforms to detect and remove illegal content, protect children from harmful material, implement age verification, and maintain transparent content moderation practices. Non-compliance results in fines up to £18 million or 10% of global revenue, criminal sanctions for senior managers, and business disruption orders. SafetyKit provides AI-powered infrastructure that enables platforms to achieve OSA compliance in under a week. Already deployed by leading global marketplaces and social platforms, our customers maintain regulatory compliance across UK, EU, and US frameworks while processing millions of daily content moderation decisions. What the Act Requires The Online Safety Act applies to platforms hosting user-generated content or facilitating user interaction, including social media, messaging apps, video-sharing sites, marketplaces, dating platforms, and forums. Platform obligations: Illegal Content Detection: Identify and remove priority offenses including CSAM, intimate image abuse, fraud, terrorism, harassment, and suicide promotion. Implement perceptual hashing and integrate with industry databases (NCMEC, IWF). Child Safety Protections: Filter age-inappropriate content including pornography, eating disorder content, bullying, and self-harm promotion away from users under 18. Highly Effective Age Assurance (HEAA): Verify user ages through government ID, credit card checks, facial estimation, or third-party digital identity services. Algorithm Risk Assessments: Document how recommendation systems expose users to illegal content or children to harmful content. Generate quantitative data for Ofcom audits. Transparency Documentation: Log every detection and enforcement action with timestamps. Publish transparency reports and maintain audit trails. Failure to comply results in fines up to £18 million or 10% of global revenue (whichever is greater), criminal sanctions for senior managers, and business disruption orders requiring UK ISPs to block platform access. How SafetyKit Enables Compliance SafetyKit's AI risk and safety platform helps enterprises meet core OSA content moderation requirements without rebuilding trust and safety infrastructure. With over 200 ready-to-implement policies, platforms can start moderating content immediately across 193+ languages. Automated Content Detection – Identify all OSA priority offenses across images, video, and text in real time, including CSAM, NCII, AI-generated deepfakes, fraud, violent extremism, harassment, and self-harm content. Support for 193+ languages ensures no content is missed. Child Safety Filtering – Filter age-inappropriate content away from children while maintaining full platform access for adults. Re-Upload Prevention – Detect previously identified NCII and CSAM at upload, even when modified through cropping, resizing, or color adjustment. Integration with industry databases and custom policy enforcement. Algorithm Risk Analytics – Track content distribution patterns, recommendation outputs, and user exposure to harmful content by age cohort. Complete algorithm risk assessments with the quantitative data Ofcom requires. Ofcom-Ready Audit Trails – Automatically log every detection, review decision, and enforcement action. Generate transparency reports and respond to information requests in days. Regulatory Adaptation – Adapt to new priority offenses and transparency requirements with minimal engineering lift. Stay compliant as regulations evolve. Take Action Now Ofcom is actively enforcing OSA requirements with substantial penalties. Organizations that proactively address compliance gain competitive advantages: reduced regulatory risk, stronger user trust, and operational readiness for future regulations. SafetyKit enables OSA compliance in under a week. Contact us to discuss your compliance strategy and see how our AI-powered platform protects users while meeting Ofcom requirements. The Online Safety Act represents a new era in platform accountability. Platforms that take decisive action now will be better positioned to protect users, maintain compliance, and navigate the evolving regulatory landscape.
